info.title: Image storage service
info.description: Documentation automatically generated by the swagger-autogen module.

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of images matching the given filters.

User-defined fields stored under `data` can be filtered using explicit full field paths:
- Dot notation: `?data.label=cat`
- Bracket notation: `?data[label]=cat`
- Nested fields: `?data[parentKey][nestedKey]=value`

**Deprecated:** The shorthand syntax `?label=cat` is deprecated. Use `?data.label=cat` instead. Shorthand filters trigger a `Deprecation: true` response header and will be removed in the next major version.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Filter by file path (exact match, or partial when regex=true)

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Field path to sort by (e.g. data.label, time)

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort order: 1 for ascending (default), -1 for descending

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 100, max: 1000)

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default: 0)

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Filter images with time >= this ISO 8601 date

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Filter images with time <= this ISO 8601 date

parameters.name: regex
parameters.description: Set to true to enable case-insensitive partial (substring) matching on string filter values

parameters.name: coerce
parameters.description: Set to true to coerce query-string values to their native types (number, boolean, null) before filtering

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: URL-encoded JSON MongoDB query object for advanced filtering (e.g. {"data.label":{"$in":["cat","dog"]}})

parameters.name: select
parameters.description: Space- or comma-separated list of fields to include in the response

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: One or more MongoDB ObjectId strings to fetch by ID

parameters.name: data.{key}
parameters.description: Filter by a user-defined field using dot notation. Example: data.label=cat. Nested fields: data.parent.child=value. Use this form instead of the deprecated shorthand ?key=value.

parameters.name: data[{key}]
parameters.description: (Deprecated shorthand) Filter by a bare key name, e.g. ?label=cat. This is equivalent to ?data.label=cat but is deprecated and will be removed in the next major version. Using it returns a Deprecation: true response header.

400.description: Bad Request — malformed filter, disallowed operator, or limit exceeded

delete.description: Deletes images matching the given filters. Accepts the same filter query parameters as GET /images/.
